verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch offers self-hosting with 'full data ownership' and is open-source (MIT), which lets an organization control where data lives and effectively manage retention/deletion by owning the infrastructure. However, there is no explicit documentation of account/data deletion tools, configurable retention periods, or export/erasure APIs for the cloud-hosted version. Missing for 10: explicit data retention/deletion controls or APIs, documented GDPR-style erasure workflow, and independent confirmation that self-hosting alone satisfies deletion requirements.
